verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://pika.art/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Markdown summary of Pika. That file lists the product's apps and models and points agents to the Pika API Club and to the Pika MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible agents, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt links to in-depth agent-oriented API/MCP reference docs rather than mainly a product catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it successfully.
